source: Stars: IAU SOFA 20231011 through astropy 8.0.2 (pyerfa 2.0.1.5), FK5 J2000 to AltAz, pressure 0. Planets: NASA JPL Horizons API, observer table quantity 4, APPARENT=AIRLESS.
capturedBy: Claude Code session at the owner's request (2026-10-23); the owner reviews the PR
settings: Observer at the site's lat/lon, 0 m, WGS-84; instant in UTC; no refraction; azimuth from north through east; degrees. Star inputs are the template's J2000 RA/Dec from the vendored Yale catalogue, proper motion not applied.
notes: The US Naval Observatory's service was unreachable (connection reset), so SOFA stands in for it. Horizons' planets agree with astropy's own built-in positions within 0.005 deg.
